seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [target] show mixed outcomes: x x2, pixels,x x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: state accumulated across earlier steps that the frame does not show. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Board = 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks; axis = wall row with most corner-10 blocks, selected when its centre dot is 0.
Pieces = 5-ring blocks; selected piece grown from 0-centre blocks through non-9 centres; targets = blocks containing 11.
A1/A2 move selection one row (axis unblocked), A3/A4 move pieces a column, blocked by edge/other pieces; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Reflections drawn as 4 blocks at row 2A-r (skip off-board/piece blocks); layers piece>refl>target>axis; HUD col 63 one 11->12 per effective action.
The reflection A1 'x vs pixels,x' mix is re-extraction under occlusion by targets, not hidden state; program is stateless. Unconfirmed: pieces entering the axis row.
